method:
Source-specific independent audit; never imports or invokes the parser.

Boundaries and routed-wire labels below were established by reading all six
original ASCII files. This is an audit fixture, not a general-purpose parser.
Run from any directory: python /absolute/path/to/independent_check.py

nodes.label: inserts a new diagram GridBox + GridContent into a container

alternative_if_prose_bullets_are_trees.label: GridBox ids are unique within a scene; positions, sizes, and bounds are integers.
A collapsed GridBox must name collapsed content; expanded minimumSize reserves space.
Only settled Representations are openable and shown by the explorer.
Projection target project, Representation, and Revision must match the pinned target.
Saving uses Draft.revisionId as expectedRevisionId, then advances it to the saved revision.
A Draft is dirty when its current name or serialized scene differs from its saved baseline.

nodes.label: rectangle: line/column range in active DiagramContent
rewrites active DiagramContent + mappings, then relayouts scene
creates DiagramContent + diagram GridBox in container/root
rendered ASCII rows -------> CallTreeNode.id + source line
visible rows = linked tree lines + ancestors
LocalChatThread [0..*] (conversation scoped to a selected region)
CanvasView (interaction state; does not alter the domain document)
focused GridBox is centered by its rendered bounds
GridBox ids are unique across a LineGridScene.
Positions, sizes, gaps, and resolved bounds are integers.
A collapsed GridBox must reference collapsed content.
Expanded containers derive bounds from children and optional minimumSize.
Collapsed boxes ignore the expanded minimumSize reservation.
A DiagramProjection is valid only for its pinned project, representation, and revision.
Saving uses expectedRevisionId and advances the draft to the returned current revision.
generate -> inserts a new DiagramGridBox + GridContent
validates unique GridBox ids and integer geometry
resolves relative positions into absolute bounds
ProjectProjectionRecord + pinned target revision + selected Evidence ids
GridBox union and resolved geometry: lineGrid.ts
Selection, patch, and sub-diagram generation: MappingPocSelectionCanvas.tsx
Status: settled diagrams appear in the explorer
evidence: source evidence used to reconstruct mappings

position: column, row relative to parent
minimumSize?: columns, rows reserved when expanded
collapsedContentId?: required when collapsed --> Grid content
bounds: absolute column, row, columns, rows
contentId: collapsed content or expanded diagram content
children[]: resolved children of expanded containers

drafts [by representation id; retained when switching diagrams]
revisionId --> revision used for the next save

Create: name + initial ASCII, or current scene + sourceRevisionId
Navigation guard: unsaved changes or busy drafts
Explorer: filter representations; focus boxes in active scene
Gestures: pan, pinch, anchored zoom, reset, focus box
Active box --> GridBox and its Grid content
Selection rectangle: startLine, endLine, startColumn, endColumn
Selected nodes: node heads intersecting the rectangle
Source context: source ranges and selected evidence ids
Replace active content --> relayout scene --> commit document
Target parent --> source container or root canvas
New content + diagram box --> insert --> commit document
Selection projections [source evidence to source files]
nodes [by id]: text, line, order, parentId, childIds[]
Source pane: open file and mapped source ranges
Transcript: user text and assistant Markdown
Actions: submit, retry, change verbosity, collapse
evidence?: source evidence used to derive mappings
bounds: absolute column, row, columns, rows

Collapsed box requires content and ignores minimumSize

Intersecting node heads -> selected node IDs
Result: updated ASCII, revision, mappings and line range

Result -> new diagram box and new content
Insert into document -> activate generated box

id, text, line, order, parentId, childIds

Actions: submit follow-up, retry, change verbosity, collapse
